statistics.locator: Section 3.2 paragraph following Equation (6), referring explicitly to Table 2 standard deviation
statistics.qualification: Section 3.2, paragraph following Equation (6), explicitly identifies the Table 2 Young's modulus variability as standard deviation. The central aggregation and sample count are not stated. Preserve the numeric absolute SD independently of the unknown central statistic; do not infer mean, median, SEM, confidence interval, coverage factor, population, independent batches or replicate count.

identity_and_composition.ingredient_scope: Section 2.1 names PLA literally as Ingeos Biopolymer 4043D supplied by Nature Works LLC, and PCL Capa 6500 supplied by Perstorp Specialty Chemicals AB. These are ingredient context only, not a finished-blend grade, certified purity or exact tested-lot identification. The Introduction states that no coupling agent was incorporated; this does not establish that all commercial additives are absent.
identity_and_composition.distinction: The finite 22-input audit at baseline 437950c414ea340eda340babe7b63dee9fcee535 is reproducible with the adjacent build_identity_review.py and identity-review.json. The seven explicit nominal PLA/PCL mass recipes are absent from recorded formulation scopes. Existing Porima PLA, Ultimaker Tough PLA and Proto-pasta conductive PLA have incomplete full-composition disclosure; unknown additives do not prove PCL absence or global non-equivalence. Tough PLA is one identity with Black and White states and unspecified acrylic chemistry, not verified PMMA. Nominal recipe differences support conditional distinct candidate identities; source year, labels, suppliers, processing, specimens and differing modulus values alone do not.
identity_and_composition.locale_status: English fallback in en, zh, ja and de; no native-language translation review claimed.

processing.drying: 60 degrees C until constant weight before processing
processing.mixing: Internal mixer at 190 degrees C and 80 rpm until constant torque
processing.storage: 60 degrees C oven to prevent moisture absorption before molding
processing.molding_qualification: Section 2.3 lists five heating zones at 175, 180, 185, 185 and 190 degrees C and an injection-pressure range of 330-600 bar. Section 3.1 says both injection-molding temperature and pressure were modified according to blend melt flow index. Retain these as reported setup/range context only; exact per-formulation temperature and pressure settings are unresolved, and no universal molding recipe is assigned to the seven states.

tensile_method.definition: Source-reported conventional tensile Young's modulus from injection-molded specimens, tested on an Instron 1122 with a 5-kN load cell according to source-cited ISO 527-1:2012, at a crosshead speed of 2 mm/min and a clamp separation of 115 mm. The modulus-fit interval, strain estimator and extensometer gauge length are not stated.

independent_transcription_audit.scope: Cached XML/HTML selected rows, ordered authors, CC BY 4.0 permissions and existing uncertainty/classification contract; not independent scientific review or replication.

exclusions: Pure-component Table 1 rows B100/0 and B0/100; no new neat PLA/PCL identities or constituent-grade records.
All tensile-strength, strain, impact, MFI, density and other property values; all computed rule-of-mixtures/Voigt-Reuss values and commercial comparison data.
MFI conditions 210 degrees C, 2.16 kg and ISO 1133-1; flexural ISO 178 and impact ISO 179 are not tensile-modulus conditions.
